verdict.rationale: ROS 2 provides strong on-robot data capture via rosbag (record/play, Python API for custom recording) and configurable QoS policies for tuning network reliability, but there is no evidence of any built-in cloud-sync mechanism or bandwidth-aware upload policy — bags are local artifacts and QoS applies to live DDS pub/sub between nodes, not to offloading recorded data to a cloud backend. Missing for 10: cloud upload/sync capability, bandwidth-aware transfer policies, any first-party cloud integration or partner tooling for telemetry sync.
